data.one_liner: A simple animated checkmark icon widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedCheck widget that renders an animated checkmark icon. Uses an AnimationController and a Tween to control the progress of the checkmark animation.
use_when: You need an animated checkmark icon for success states
You want a lightweight widget driven by a standard AnimationController
avoid_when: You need a complex multi-step success animation beyond a checkmark
You are looking for a complete UI component kit
strengths: Integrates easily with standard Flutter AnimationController
weaknesses: Very limited scope (only provides an animated checkmark)
Not documented with extensive customization options
